fmea_rows.failure_mode: Protection circuit fails to trip at rated voltage
fmea_rows.effect: Cell over-charged; swelling, possible thermal event
fmea_rows.prevention_control: Component-level BMS IC screening; design margin per IEC 62133-2
fmea_rows.detection_control: 100% functional charge/discharge test at FATP Stn 6 (Section 6.2)
fmea_rows.recommended_action: Add redundant hardware over-voltage cutoff independent of firmware

fmea_rows.failure_mode: Creepage distance below IEC 62368-1 minimum due to layout/tooling drift
fmea_rows.prevention_control: DFM review against IEC 62368-1 clearance table; 3D CAD tolerance check
fmea_rows.recommended_action: Add design guard-band (+20%) beyond minimum spec; incoming PCB dimensional AQL check

fmea_rows.failure_mode: Cell exceeds safe temperature during fast charge
fmea_rows.effect: Cell degradation; in extreme case, thermal event
fmea_rows.prevention_control: Thermal simulation at design stage; charge-current derating curve
fmea_rows.detection_control: Thermal camera spot-check at FATP (sample basis)
fmea_rows.recommended_action: Validate thermal derating curve against IEC 62133-2 thermal abuse test; add thermal sample plan to OQC (Section 7.3)

fmea_rows.failure_mode: RF performance degrades (dropouts) due to antenna detuning near body/cable routing
fmea_rows.effect: Poor user experience; BT SIG conformance risk
fmea_rows.prevention_control: RF simulation during design; BQB pre-conformance test at EVT
fmea_rows.detection_control: BT SIG conformance test at DVT (Section 8.1)
fmea_rows.recommended_action: Re-tune antenna matching network after EVT mechanical design freeze

fmea_rows.effect: Localized heating in use; possible connection failure
fmea_rows.prevention_control: Weld process DOE at design stage; pull-force spec defined
fmea_rows.detection_control: Pull-force spot check at FATP Stn 2 (Section 6.2)
fmea_rows.recommended_action: Complete weld-process qualification (Cpk study) before PVT; add 100% weld-energy logging

fmea_rows.failure_mode: Pin retention force below spec after repeated insertion cycles
fmea_rows.effect: Loose plug connection; intermittent power, possible arcing
fmea_rows.prevention_control: Material selection per plug mechanism vendor datasheet
fmea_rows.detection_control: Sample insertion-cycle life test at DVT (Section 8.1)
fmea_rows.recommended_action: Run 5,000-cycle insertion life test at DVT; tighten plating spec if marginal

fmea_rows.failure_mode: Seam separation under drop or flex load
fmea_rows.effect: Water ingress risk (IPX5 failure); cosmetic field return
fmea_rows.prevention_control: DFM review of wall-thickness tolerance vs. weld window
fmea_rows.detection_control: Seam visual check + sample IPX5 retest at FATP Stn 5/8 (Section 6.1)
fmea_rows.recommended_action: Widen shell wall-thickness tolerance or increase weld energy margin

fmea_rows.failure_mode: Port de-solders / loosens from PCBA under cable insertion force
fmea_rows.prevention_control: Use through-hole reinforced USB-C connector footprint
fmea_rows.detection_control: Sample cable-insertion cycle test at DVT
fmea_rows.recommended_action: Switch to through-hole/SMT hybrid connector footprint

fmea_rows.failure_mode: Wrong battery lot pulled to line (incl. quarantined lot)
fmea_rows.effect: Traceability break; possible use of non-conforming lot
fmea_rows.prevention_control: PLM lot-status gating (quarantined lots blocked from pick list)
fmea_rows.recommended_action: Enforce mandatory scan-verification at every pick (no manual override)

fmea_rows.effect: Intermittent power; field return / no-power complaint
fmea_rows.prevention_control: Solder temp profile logged per lot; oven PM schedule
fmea_rows.detection_control: 100% functional test at Stn 7; sample X-ray on new lot start-up

fmea_rows.effect: Localized heating in use; possible connection failure
fmea_rows.prevention_control: Weld process window qualified (Cpk); electrode PM schedule
fmea_rows.recommended_action: Add real-time weld-energy SPC chart with auto-hold on trend (Athena Line Twin, Section 2.4)

fmea_rows.failure_mode: Protection trip test skipped or mis-recorded
fmea_rows.effect: Non-conforming unit released to next station undetected
fmea_rows.prevention_control: Standard work instruction; test mandatory in station sequence
fmea_rows.detection_control: MES station interlock — cannot advance without logged pass
fmea_rows.recommended_action: Remove manual override capability; hard interlock in line controller

fmea_rows.failure_mode: Unit bypasses Hi-Pot test station (line jam / operator reroute)
fmea_rows.effect: Non-isolation-tested unit reaches pack; shock hazard risk
fmea_rows.prevention_control: Fixed station sequence in line layout
fmea_rows.detection_control: MES serial-number gate — unit cannot reach pack station without logged Hi-Pot pass
fmea_rows.recommended_action: Confirm MES hard-gate is active at pack station for 100% of adapter serials before SOP

fmea_rows.failure_mode: AI defect-vision model misses a real scratch/flash defect (false negative)
fmea_rows.effect: Cosmetic defect reaches customer; return / brand impact
fmea_rows.prevention_control: AOI model trained on pilot-run image set (Section 2.4)
fmea_rows.detection_control: Sample manual audit (patrol QA) per Section 7.2
fmea_rows.recommended_action: Retrain AOI model on each new shell color/finish before ramp; increase manual audit sampling for first week of a new variant

fmea_rows.failure_mode: Mismatched serials combined into one kit (wrong neckband with wrong powerbank/adapter)
fmea_rows.effect: Genealogy record corrupted for that kit; hampers future traceability
fmea_rows.prevention_control: Automated scan-match required to close kit record in PLM
fmea_rows.detection_control: System rejects kit close on scan mismatch
fmea_rows.recommended_action: Periodic audit of kit-match logs; disable manual-entry fallback

fmea_rows.failure_mode: Creepage/clearance visual check skipped under line-rate pressure
fmea_rows.effect: Marginal-clearance unit passes to next station undetected
fmea_rows.prevention_control: Standard work instruction; posted reference boundary samples
fmea_rows.detection_control: Downstream 100% Hi-Pot test at Stn 5 as backstop
fmea_rows.recommended_action: Add fixture-based go/no-go clearance gauge instead of visual-only check
